page.layout: Full-width row of two portrait medallions at the top, left and right, each with a caption around its rim. Below them, one block of running text in two paragraphs. A woodcut ornament sits at the foot of the text, not part of the text. Running head at top right, page number at top left.

main_text.l: DEBORA Prophetissa, vxor Lapidoth, Israëliticum po-
pulum iudicauit anno à mundo condito 2659. ante Christum
natum 1303. Hæc Barac exercitui suo præfecit, atque vnà cum
eo aduersus Sisaram, ducè exercitus Iabin, Regis Chananæo-
rum, commigrauit: fusa ac prostrata aduersariorum acie, Sisara
ipse præceps de curru delapsus, fugam arripuit, atque à muliere
Iahel susceptus, & statim epoto lacte obdormiens, defixo per
tempora clauo, ab eadem caput cõsuitur, somnóque soporife-
rum lethum adiicitur. Vide librum Iudicum, capite tertio.
BARAC filius Abinoam, de tribu Nepthalim, præfectus
fuit exercitui Deboræ, sicuti supra dictũ à me est. hic Dux for-
tissimus, decem hominum millibus tantùm assumptis, exerci-
tum Sisaræ, longè copiosiorem, imò bis decies ampliorem ad
vnum confecit, ac deleuit. Verùm enimuerò, spes ac fiducia in
Deum obsirmatissima, præcipua ac potiora erant arma & vires,
quibus freti Debora & Barac, insolescētes hostes eneruarunt.
Videto lib. Iudicum ca. 4. & Iosephum li. Antiquitatum 5. ca. 9:

page.notes: Two medallion portraits (woodcut busts in circles) are printed above the text: the left one is captioned around its rim with letters "RA." and "DELBO", partly unclear (probably DEBORA, rotated), so marked [?]; the right one is captioned "BARACH". Woodcut ornament at the foot of the page, no text. Long s and ligatures normalised to plain s and the letters as printed, e.g. "fortissimus" written as "fortissimus" in the main text; the printed forms s are rendered as s. Captions of the medallions are taken from the image, not from memory.
